title_fr: Cliniques et structures de soins d'Algérie
title_ar: عيادات ومرافق الرعاية الصحية في الجزائر
coverage_note: Clinics and proximity-care facilities from OpenStreetMap. A community-maintained extract, NOT an official registry: it mixes the public proximity tier (polycliniques, salles de soins, centres de santé) with private clinics and maternities, and coverage is partial and uneven by wilaya. It complements @geoalgeria/sante, which carries the Ministry of Health registry tier (CHU/EPH/EHS/EPSP) that is excluded here; the two describe different populations and must not be summed.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap: clinics & proximity-care facilities in Algeria

linkage_note: wilaya_code is derived by point-in-polygon against the 69 wilaya boundaries; commune is the nearest centroid WITHIN that wilaya, so the join never crosses a wilaya boundary. Wilaya is effectively exact, commune is best-effort.
